summary: Piedmont Realty Trust filed an 8-K updating acquisition and disposition activity and capital markets plans. On September 10, 2026 it acquired 4075 Wilson Boulevard, a 189,000 sq ft Ballston, Arlington Class A office building, for a net purchase price of about $52.7 million; the asset is 83% leased with 5.5-year weighted-average lease term. It also completed the $12.0 million Royal Lane land sale in Dallas and contracted to sell office properties for roughly $80 million, expected to close in Q4 2026. Separately, the operating partnership announced a proposed $200 million private Rule 144A offering of exchangeable senior notes due 2031, fully guaranteed by the Company. Watch due diligence and closing risk on the pending disposition, plus notes pricing and exchange-premium terms.
